name: Tenkawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tenkawa village emblem in green: a stylised mountain peak with a curved base.
history: Municipal flag of Tenkawa, a village in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 July 1971.

features.role: Tenkawa village emblem — a stylised mountain peak with a curved base
